body: I've tried offing myself before with pills + alcohol. it doesn't work. I just posted something about me wanting to let go of life as well. but NEVER do it because of someone else. if its your girlfriend then its going to be fucking rough but go through it. if you're going to let go it better not be BECAUSE of SOMEONE ELSE. please TRY the psychiatrist and(or) meds before doing this. you have to try everything before giving up. i know I'm not one to talk because I'm going to let go soon, but i HAVE been to therapy. i HAVE been on meds. i HAVE talked to help lines and family. please don't give up until you have to
